gizmo.title: Boka reStop Note
gizmo.description: Unganidza stop note dzakawanda mubhuroko rimwe rinoratidza chinyorwa chimwe panguva, seMazano kana Zvitsva. Makadhi emirayiridzo, zvinyorwa zvepadivi nemitsara ine furemu zvinogona kuunganidzwa nazvo.
